<thought>We need to determine which of the candidate SMILES strings correspond to the molecular formula C₁₈H₂₁NO inferred from the mass spectrum. I will query the molecular formula for each candidate using the get_formula_from_smiles tool.</thought>
<action>get_formula_from_smiles</action>
<action_input>{"smiles": "CC1C2C=CC=CC2C3C1C4=C(N3C)C=CC(=C4)OC"}</action_input>

<thought>Next candidate.</thought>
<action>get_formula_from_smiles</action>
<action_input>{"smiles": "CCCCCC1=CC=C(C=C1)C2=NC=C(C=C2)C(=O)C"}</action_input>

<thought>Next candidate.</thought>
<action>get_formula_from_smiles</action>
<action_input>{"smiles": "COC1=CC=CC(=C1)C(C2=CC=C(C=C2)C3CCC3)N"}</action_input>

<thought>Next candidate.</thought>
<action>get_formula_from_smiles</action>
<action_input>{"smiles": "CNCCCC1C2=CC=CC=C2COC3=CC=CC=C13"}</action_input>

<thought>Last candidate.</thought>
<action>get_formula_from_smiles</action>
<action_input>{"smiles": "CCC1=CC=C(C=C1)N(C)C2=CC=C(C=C2)C(=O)CC"}</action_input>
